SEN.note: Consumer protection appears only as an ITU negotiating theme, not digital finance rules.
Only operator investment and taxes are given; no government financing of digital transformation.

facts.fact: The author says Senegal's national Internet exchange point, launched in 2017, appears little used, citing little public knowledge of its traffic.

SEN.note: Nothing on regional infrastructure projects for Senegal.
The ATU proposals are continental and a Senegal code revision is only mentioned in passing.
